theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrfic_divergence_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (ι : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) (a : Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) γ → StrictMono ι → ∃ G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G ∧ (∀ y, ‖G y‖ ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm (γ (a + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ y, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G y) = exteriorDerivative γ (a + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))
